value.rationale: As contractions approach the noncompact boundary the Schatten distance between differently rotated derivative-composition operators diverges. Its sharp leading constant is a canonical operator-ideal invariant and exhibits three structurally distinct angular scales: fixed irrational/Haar, exact rational resonance, and order-t detuning. The quartic resonance profile strictly undershoots both endpoint averages, revealing nonmonotone spectral separation not visible in known membership criteria or single-operator norm estimates. This is a natural full-parameter classification in a motivated family, not an arbitrary finite slice.
